_comment: Model-specific saved effort + named purpose profiles, independent of OMP's built-in modelRoles. Owned by omp/extensions/profiles + omp/profiles.ts. Exact catalog IDs/contextWindow/maxTokens verified against the installed `omp models --json` catalog on 2026-09-07 (not vendor-advertised specs, which run higher for the openai-codex models below -- the installed catalog figure is what the running session actually budgets against). Effort values marked 'starting point' are NOT claimed optima; adjust via /effort or `bun omp/profiles.ts effort set`.

frontend.purpose: Fable 5.1 for frontend/UI-facing work and general daily driving

orchestrate.purpose: Fable 5.1 orchestrating parallel subagents / task delegation

hard-code.purpose: Fable 5.1 for difficult coding and implementation

general.purpose: Sol at reduced (medium) effort for general/noncoding tasks

opus-code.purpose: Opus 5 for everyday coding at high effort

opus-general.purpose: Opus 5 for noncoding work at medium effort

best.purpose: Astra for the user's highest-quality general-purpose work

economical.purpose: Luna at max effort for economical general-purpose work

mechanical.purpose: AGY Flash for mechanical, well-defined edits

media.purpose: AGY Flash for media processing tasks

fallback.purpose: AGY Opus 4.6 Thinking as an explicit-budget fallback when other models/budgets are exhausted; the model exposes no effort selector
